groups.name: True Detective Season 1
groups.explanation: Rust Cohle and Martin Hart are the two lead detectives; Alexandra Daddario guest-starred as Lisa Tragnetti, Hart's mistress; and Reggie Ledoux is the cook and murder suspect the detectives pursue — all from True Detective Season 1 (HBO, 2014).

groups.name: Fictional TV small towns defined by dark secrets hidden beneath a wholesome surface
groups.explanation: Fernwood, Ohio (Mary Hartman, Mary Hartman) harbors murder and scandal beneath its soap-opera suburban surface; Cicely, Alaska (Northern Exposure) is an eccentric isolated town with strange undercurrents; Wayward Pines, Idaho (Wayward Pines) is literally a prison town hiding a post-apocalyptic secret; Eureka, Oregon (Grimm) is an ordinary-seeming town where supernatural creatures live in secret among humans.

groups.name: TV characters who discover mid-series that a parent or parental figure ordered or committed a killing
groups.explanation: Dana Brody (Homeland) learns her father Nicholas Brody carried out a killing; Meadow Soprano (The Sopranos) gradually confronts the reality that her father Tony is a murderer; Walter White Jr. (Breaking Bad) discovers by the final season that his father Walt is a drug kingpin responsible for deaths; D'Angelo Barksdale (The Wire) is raised in the Barksdale organization and comes to understand his uncle Avon's empire is built on murder.

groups.name: Characters played by actors who won a SAG Award as part of a TV ensemble
groups.explanation: Paulie Walnuts (Tony Sirico, The Sopranos — SAG ensemble winner); Stringer Bell (Idris Elba, The Wire — SAG ensemble nominee/winner); Titus Pullo (Ray Stevenson, Rome — SAG ensemble nominee); Tobias Fünke (David Cross, Arrested Development — SAG ensemble winner 2004 and 2005). All four actors received SAG Awards or nominations as part of their respective prestige TV casts.
